notes.title: Further Balance Changes
notes.notes:
🎲 Hi everyone! A little balance patch just went live. Here are the changes: 🎲

Artifacts

First to Strike Plus - The score of the first two hands played is multiplied by 4 and has its multiplier cap increased by 250. (Was 6)
Loaded Dice - All scores multiplied by 1.3. The face up value of the loaded die when the round begins is more likely to roll. (Was 1.4)
Lucky Sevens - Unlimited -> Limit 2
Lucky Sevens Plus - Unlimited -> Limit 2
One Up - Limit 5 -> 1


Cursed Artifacts

Problematic Pentas - Playing a Penta has a 20% chance for the score to be multiplied by 0. (Was 25%)
Questionable Quads - Playing a Quadra has a 20% chance for the score to be multiplied by 0. (Was 25%)
Rough Neighborhood - Playing a Full House has a 20% chance for the score to be multiplied by 0. (Was 25%)
The Dumpster - Playing Anything Goes has a 20% chance for the score to be multiplied by 0. (Was 25%)
Trippy Trips - Playing a Triple has a 20% chance for the score to be multiplied by 0. (Was 25%)
Winding Roads - Playing a Straight has a 10% chance for the score to be multiplied by 0. (Was 15%)
Crooked Path - Decreases the base score of all Straights by 7. (Was 10)
Thrice Was Nice - Decreases the base score of a Triple by 5. (Was 6)
Stole My Penta - Decreases the base score of a Penta by 15. (Was 16)
Eviction Notice - Decreases the base score of a Full House by 6. (Was 7)


Have a great weekend and good luck on your runs!

notes.title: Major Balance Changes
notes.notes:
General Changes


The base score of a Penta is now 55. (Was 50)
Charging Up & Charging Up Plus no longer appear in the shop until rounds 15 and onward.
Artifacts with a percent chance to roll a Baby Straight on the come out roll have a 33% chance to roll 5-4-3-2-X, X will never be 1 or 6 on the come out roll. This change is intended to synergize with the recently added Countdown artifact (Scoring a Large Straight with the sequence 5-4-3-2-1 grants 14% of the required points. Large Straight can be played one additional time.)
Artifacts with a percent chance to roll a Large Straight on the come out roll have a 25% chance to roll 5-4-3-2-1. This change is intended to synergize with the recently added Countdown artifact (Scoring a Large Straight with the sequence 5-4-3-2-1 grants 14% of the required points. Large Straight can be played one additional time.)


Artifacts


Chaotic Conundrum - All scores multiplied by 4. Artifacts are chosen at random. (Was 3)
Cutting Corners - All scores multiplied by 1.4. The number of pips required to unlock the bonus is decreased by 8. (Was 10)
Cutting Corners Plus - All scores multiplied by 1.7. The number of pips required to unlock the bonus is decreased by 15. (Was 20)
Dice Disorder - All scores multiplied by 2.2. Two dice lose the ability to lock their roll. (Was 2.0)
Enhanced Penta - 2.5% Chance to roll a Penta on come out roll. Penta can be played one additional time. (Was 2%)
Enhanced Penta Plus - 5% Chance to roll a Penta on come out roll. Penta can be played two additional times. (Was 4%)
Loaded Dice - All scores multiplied by 1.4. The face up value of the loaded die when the round begins is more likely to roll. (Was 1.5)
Out Of Control - All scores multiplied by 2.3. The number of choices in the shop are reduced to 2. They cannot be refreshed. (Was 2.0)
Penta Perfection - All scores multiplied by 1.5. 2% Chance to roll a Penta on come out roll. (Was 1.5%)
Penta Perfection Plus - All scores multiplied by 1.7. 4% Chance to roll a Penta on come out roll. (Was 3%)
Pete And Repeat Plus - 5% Chance to roll a Baby Straight on come out roll. Baby Straight can be played two additional times. (Was 4.5%)
Plenty Of Room Plus - 4% Chance to roll a Full House on come out roll. Full House can be played two additional times. (Was 3%)
Sacrificial Dice - All scores multiplied by 3.5. The amount of times you may reroll dice is reduced by 1. (Was 4)
Tannersville - 2% Chance to roll a Full House on come out roll. Full House has its multiplier cap increased by 70x, X is the difference in the pair and three of a kind. (Was 60)
Thrice Is Nice - Triple can be played one additional time and has its multiplier cap increased by 80. (Was 100)
Thrice Is Nice Plus - Triple can be played two additional times and has its multiplier cap increased by 160. (Was 175)
Trifecta Plus - After scoring a Triple, Quadra and Penta, gain 18% of the required points. Can only trigger once per round. (Was 16%)
Trips Everywhere - All scores multiplied by 1.4. Playing a hand that contains a three of a kind has its multiplier cap increased by 60. (Was 75)
Trips Everywhere Plus - All scores multiplied by 1.7. Playing a hand that contains a three of a kind has its multiplier cap increased by 110. (Was 125)
Window Shopping - Increased chance to roll rare artifacts decreased to 2%. (Was 3%)
Window Shopping Plus - Increased chance to roll rare artifacts decreased to 4%. (Was 6%)


Cursed Artifacts


Bonus Trip Up - The bonus score is multiplied by 0.8. The number of pips required to unlock the bonus increases by 5. (Was 0.75)
It's Probably Harmless - On every score submission, there is a 8% chance the submitted score is multiplied by 0.5. (Was 10%)
Problematic Pentas - Playing a Penta has a 25% chance for the score to be multiplied by 0. (Was 30%)
Questionable Quads - Playing a Quadra has a 25% chance for the score to be multiplied by 0. (Was 30%)
Rough Neighborhood - Playing a Full House has a 25% chance for the score to be multiplied by 0. (Was 30%)
The Dumpster - Playing Anything Goes has a 25% chance for the score to be multiplied by 0. (Was 30%)
Trippy Trips - Playing a Triple has a 25% chance for the score to be multiplied by 0. (Was 30%)
Unsturdy Lock - Locked dice have a 8% chance of rolling anyway. (Was 10%)
Winding Roads - Playing a Straight has a 15% chance for the score to be multiplied by 0. (Was 20%)


Window Shopping Math (Turn back, Faz)

The base chance of rolling a plus artifact in the retail game is 5% (0% in the demo), this is unchanged. What this means is there is an 18.5% chance that at least one plus artifact will roll in your shop of 4 options, if you refresh this increases to 33.7% that after seeing 8 options, at least one will be a plus artifact.

Taking Window Shopping will increase your chance to 7%. This means there is a 25.2% chance of seeing a plus artifact in your first 4 options, and if you refresh that's a 44% chance of seeing one.

Taking just Window Shopping Plus (Not both) will increase your chance to 9%. This means there is a 31.4% chance of seeing a plus artifact in your first 4 options, and if you refresh that's a 53% chance of seeing one.

And if you have both, that's an 11% chance, which means in your first 4 options you have a 37.3% chance of seeing a plus artifact, increasing to 60.6% if you refreshed.

notes.title: New Player Experience & Miscellaneous Changes
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, another small patch was just released that I think should enhance the new player experience a quite bit.


Removed a number of artifacts from showing up in your first two good shops (Rounds 1 & 3) that really aren't great to be picking early. Newer players wouldn't know any better what to choose and it's possible they pick something that sets them off on the wrong foot. The picks available now generally have all score multipliers on them, making it easier to reach the score requirement and in fewer hands.
This should hopefully also speed up the earlier rounds which tend to play slower and give the impression that a full run of 42 rounds will take an eternity, even though the pace picks up shortly after. (A full run typically takes about an hour)

Score requirements are slightly lowered from rounds 7 to 15.
Building Blocks - Each time the same hand is played, its base points increases by 3 for the round. (Previously 2)
Building Blocks Plus - Each time the same hand is played, its base points increases by 5 for the round. (Previously 4)
The Poisonous Dice challenge reward now unlocks the Building Blocks artifacts. (Previously changed the Poisonous Dice hex modifier from 0.2 to 0.5)
A number of artifacts were showing up as options when there were no downsides to taking them if you could only roll the dice 1 time. If you could only roll the dice 1 time before having to pick a hand, anything relating to locking the dice was not relevant and essentially a freebie. The Chains That Bind, Unsturdy Lock, Dice Disorder, The Bad Shoulder, Quick Submission and No Going Back will not show up in shops if you only have 1 roll.

notes.title: Balance and Tooltip Changes
notes.notes:
🚨 Patch Time! 🚨

General Changes


Charging Up and Poisonous Dice now have tooltips to explain what emblems and hexes do, allowing the artifact descriptions to be considerably shorter. The tooltips have been reworded to give a more clear understanding as to how playing one hand with multiple emblems/hexes works.
Charging Up's tooltip erroneously stated 3 emblems were required to trigger the effect, it was actually always 2 in the code. The tooltip has been updated to state 2 emblems are required.
One Up's description now reads: All scores multiplied by 1.3. If you would lose the game, instead sacrifice this Artifact. Does not grant another artifact. (Nothing has changed, just making it clear that after you return to the shop, you do not get a new artifact)


Balance


Building Blocks (Plus) - These artifacts are no longer offered in the early game, as they're only useful after taking artifacts that increase the number of times you can play the same hand.
Charging Up - All scores multiplied by 1.4. Add two emblems to random die's faces. (All score multiplier is new)
Charging Up Plus - All scores multiplied by 1.8. Add four emblems to random die's faces. (All score multiplier is new)
Tit For Tat - All scores multiplied by 2.2. One random hand is disabled. (Was 1.9)


Check out the live demo now and join the Discord server for information about a contest to win a free copy of the full game!

https://discord.com/invite/TgHdJJDbA5

notes.title: Refreshing Changes for Rogue Rollout
notes.notes:
Patch yourself in for new updates! (Thank you ChatGPT for these corny headlines)


 Refreshing the shop has been reworked! Previously, each slot could be refreshed individually. This meant refreshing each slot was always the correct thing to do, as you could sit on your preferred option but see if anything better comes up with no risk. Now, the refresh button rerolls every slot together. Players will have to decide if it's worth giving up an option they like to see new choices.
 The reward for completing the Limited Supply challenge has changed from granting extra rerolls to unlocking the artifact Grower.
 The button to swap between artifacts and cursed artifacts in the shop has a new coat of paint. This button also has a tooltip now when hovering over it.
 A tooltip has also been added to the buttons that let you change the faces of the dice in the shop. Many players didn't understand the purpose of them until they eventually picked an artifact that added a buff or debuff to the face of a die.
 A midround tip informing players that they can hit Escape in the middle of a round to see their artifacts has been added.
 A midround tip explaining the multiplier cap has been added.
 The position of the artifacts at the top of the screen in the shop has been shifted for 16:10 aspect ratios as to not block the Settings button.

notes.title: Time for a fresh coat of patch!
notes.notes:
General Changes


Dice skins have been added to the game! Kind of. The artist is still creating them, however they've been implemented into the game. When you open that screen, you can mouse over the slots to see what you need to do to unlock them. While the skins aren't added yet, you could start to complete these tasks and you'll have access to the skins as soon as they're ready. The tasks that require you to beat the game on a particular difficulty will need to be done again even if you've already done it, however the challenge related ones should work retroactively.
Lowered the brightness on some text that users reported was like staring into the sun.
Beginning at round 50, there will be two cursed artifact shops for every one artifact shop. Ex: 50 and 51 will both be cursed artifacts, 52 will be a beneficial one, then 53 and 54 will be cursed again, and so on.
Fixed the description of Ticking Time Bomb. The correct text now reads: "The submitted score is multiplied by 1-(0.1x), where X is the number of copies of Ticking Time Bomb." (Was 0.05x)


5 New Artifacts have been added to the game. 
Note: Continuity and Countdown are using placeholder artwork for a few days


Continuity - All scores multiplied by 1.4. Straights have their multiplier cap increased by 60X, X is the number of consecutive Straights played for points.
Continuity Plus - All scores multiplied by 1.8. Straights have their multiplier cap increased by 110X, X is the number of consecutive Straights played for points.
Countdown - Scoring a Large Straight with the sequence 5-4-3-2-1 grants 14% of the required points. Large Straight can be played one additional time.
Countdown Plus - Scoring a Large Straight with the sequence 5-4-3-2-1 grants 20% of the required points. Large Straight can be played two additional times.
How FOURtunate Plus - All scores multiplied by 1.8. Quadra can be played two additional times.


Balance Changes


Trips Everywhere and it's plus variant are limited to two copies. (Previously no limit)
How FOURtunate - All scores multiplied by 1.4. Quadra can be played one additional time. (Previously two additional times)
Chance - Anything Goes score is multiplied by 0.2 to 2. Anything Goes can be played one additional time. (Prevously 0.2 to 4)
Chance Plus - Anything Goes score is multiplied by 0.5 to 3. Anything Goes can be played two additional times. (Previously 0.5 to 5)
Chaotic Conundrum - All scores multiplied by 3. Artifacts are chosen at random. (Previously 2.8)
Cutting Corners - The number of pips required to unlock the bonus is decreased by 10. (Was 15)
Challenge Reward - 5% Reduced Change of Unsturdy Locks Triggering (Previously 10%)

notes.title: Another Day, Another Patch!
notes.notes:
Additional tooltips have been added at various places in the game. One day, everyone will be aware of the scoring panel.
The UI now says your current round out of 42, the goal. While watching some streams, players don't recall what the goal is. It will say Current Round: XX (Endless) after 42.
The Good Shoulder's percent chance to gain points has been reduced to 10%. (From 20%)
Window Shopping and it's Plus variant have lost the extra shop rerolls, but the chance of rare artifacts appearing has increased.
Lucky Sevens Plus' score of the seventh hand played is multiplied by 7. (From 17)
Snake Eyes - Everyone's favorite freebie to stack can only be chosen one time. In addition, the score multiplier is now 0.1. (From 0.4)


Good luck, Rogue Rollers!

notes.title: It's patch o'clock!
notes.notes:
It's patch o'clock, added in some quality of life changes!


If you have Loaded Dice, after winning a round the die value is set back to the loaded die's value when transitioning from the game screen to the shop screen. This means no more needing to change it every round. It does not persist through game relaunches though, so if you come back to a session you'll need to set them up one more time.
Added a new Brightness option in the Settings. Hopefully no more "oof ow my eyes" comments from people with more sensitive peepers!
The Bad Shoulder/The Good Shoulder have been tweaked a bit. The Bad Shoulder no longer lowers your score, just makes it where you cannot lock dice. In addition, it only takes 2 rounds instead of 3 to turn it into The Good Shoulder. If you have modifiers making it where you can't lock 4 or 5 dice already, you won't get offered The Bad Shoulder, since there's no drawback.
The Good Shoulder's modifier was reduced from 3 to 2.3 as a result of being a bit easier to obtain, still very strong!
Added some more tooltips in a few places, such as the Achievements screen, explaining that defeating the Challenges is how these are unlocked.
